Oplan Kontra Baha summit for Greater Metro Manila

The overarching message of the summit is clear.  The scale of Metro Manila’s flooding crisis demands a multi-front strategy, integrating heavy machinery, engineering, science and frontier technologies with a fundamental shift in public behavior.
